project.title: D&D 5e Point-Buy Calculator
project.summary: Point-buy calculator for the 2024 and 2014 D&D rules with origin and racial bonuses, locales, and shareable builds.

items.title: Return null from fromBuildFile when parseBuild fails
items.notes: fromBuildFile currently falls back to defaultBuild() when parseBuild returns null, so empty or non-numeric versioned JSON imports wipe the current build and show success. Return null instead and cover { version: 1, attributes: {} } in characterBuild tests.

items.title: Run npm run build in CI
items.notes: CI runs typecheck, lint, and test only. Add the production Vite build so asset and bundling failures cannot merge.

items.title: Apply 2024 split ASI only when both picks are set
items.notes: calculateBackgroundBonuses applies a lone +2 while plusOne is still empty. Only apply split bonuses when plusTwo and plusOne are both set, or when spread is true, so shared links and prints do not present incomplete PHB increases as final.

items.title: Move 2024 Chinese origin labels into i18n names
items.notes: Origin2024.tsx keeps local backgroundsZh and lineagesZh maps. Relocate them into src/i18n/names.ts before adding more locales so display-name conventions stay in one place.

items.title: Add component tests for share, import, and edition switch
items.notes: Codecs and racial rules are well covered by Vitest. Add a few RTL tests for import success/failure, undo/reset, and edition toggle vs URL sync around CharacterForm and BuildSync.

items.title: Add Japanese UI locale
items.notes: Enable ja in LOCALES with messages, display names, and language selector; decide whether racial trait text stays English or is translated.

items.title: Add Macedonian UI locale
items.notes: Enable mk in LOCALES with messages, display names, and language selector; decide whether racial trait text stays English or is translated.

items.title: Add Russian UI locale
items.notes: Enable ru in LOCALES with messages, display names, and language selector; decide whether racial trait text stays English or is translated.

items.title: Split RaceContext if origin surface keeps growing
items.notes: RaceContext currently owns edition, 2024 origin, and every 2014 choice setter. Justified at current size; split only if more origin systems land and the provider becomes hard to extend without coupling.
